Last Sunday, Owen and Sam went to the camping site. It takes twenty minutes to get to the camping site by bike. Both of them like dumplings and milk. In fact, the thermometer outside shows minus two.
Owen learned a lot about science. Owen usually has dumplings for breakfast. There are always many people at the river bank. We recycle paper, glass and plastic.
Owen is going to travel to Tokyo in July. Owen is reading a book about science. Owen thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. Also, the lion rested under a shady tree.
They took many photos at the river bank. Owen wrote about the day in the diary. Life is full of small surprises.
